baseline.name: Try each possible repeating block length
baseline.approach: For every candidate period up to n/2, check the string against that repeating prefix and require divisibility.
baseline.time: O(n^2) upper bound for naive repeated full-string checks

archived.name: KMP longest-prefix/suffix periodicity test
archived.time: O(n), where n is string length; fallback transitions are amortized linear

why: The LPS table reuses prefix-matching information instead of restarting a full check for every candidate block length.
quantitative_comparison: A naive candidate strategy can make up to floor(n/2) string-check attempts, each of up to n character comparisons. KMP's construction has O(n) amortized character-comparison growth. These are upper bounds; early exits and libc/compiler behavior prevent a fixed runtime factor.
tradeoffs: Uses O(n) LPS storage instead of constant auxiliary state. Allocation failure returns false, so a resource failure is not distinguishable from a nonrepeating string.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
